description: This Java class defines the response to a 'ModifyResource' command within a policy management system. It encapsulates details such as the policy ID, label, resource key, created resource, and HTTP status, and provides methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, as well as getters and serialization logic.

classes.name: ModifyResourceResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response to a ModifyResource command, including status and resource details, with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating resource creation, with deprecated variant accepting String policyId.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating resource modification, with various overloads including deprecated ones.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing relevant fields.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the associated PolicyId for this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Gets the label associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: getResourceCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Resource, if present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the resource entity as JSON, if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON Pointer path to this resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes response data into a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new response with updated Ditto headers.
